Package org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.openlineage

Class OpenLineageIcebergScanReportInputDataSetFacetMetrics

java.lang.Object
org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.openlineage.OpenLineageIcebergScanReportInputDataSetFacetMetrics
public class OpenLineageIcebergScanReportInputDataSetFacetMetrics extends Object
This class represents the scan metrics reported by Apache Iceberg for a read of a table. It is part of the OpenLineage spec.
